title: Leveraging Text Guidance for Enhancing Demographic Fairness in Gender Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the disparity in gender classification accuracy between male and female subjects, quantified by the standard deviation of accuracy (Degree of Bias) and the ratio of maximum to minimum accuracy across subgroups.

Evaluating gender classification accuracy disparities across various racial and ethnic groups (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Indian) using facial image datasets like FairFace, UTKFace, and DiveFace, measured via maximum/minimum accuracy ratios and standard deviation of accuracy.
